stem: Who amongst the following are members of the Jury to select the recipient of 'Gandhi Peace Prize'?
items: The Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha
prompt: Select the correct answer using the code given below.

ex.summary: The Gandhi Peace Prize jury is chaired by the Prime Minister; the Chief Justice of India and the Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha (or the leader of the single largest opposition party) sit ex officio, with two eminent persons. The President is not a member, so I is wrong and II, III and IV are correct.

hook: Who picks the Gandhi Peace Prize winner?

aarav.line: A national prize? Surely the President sits on it.

priya.line: PM chairs it. CJI and Opposition leader sit in.

verdicts.h: I: President: not on the jury
verdicts.p: The Code of Procedure doesn't name him.

verdicts.h: III, IV: CJI and Lok Sabha LoP
verdicts.p: Both ex officio, plus two eminent persons.

source: Prize Code of Procedure; PMO 2021; UPSC key 2025

points.p: ₹1 crore, a citation, a plaque and a handicraft/handloom item.
regardless of nationality, race, language, caste, creed or sex.
the leader of the single largest opposition party in Lok Sabha sits instead.

remember: Jury: PM + CJI + Lok Sabha LoP + two eminent persons.
trap: Aarav added the President: a national prize feels like his job, but he isn't on this jury.
method: List the chair and ex officio seats. Anyone else is out.

bonus.short: Which UK-born 2025 Nobel laureate was a professor at a US university?

reply_right: PM chairs; CJI and Lok Sabha LoP sit ex officio. President isn't.
reply_trap: The President isn't on this jury, though it's a national award.
